site_name: Gumley House Convent School For Girls
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials, including roof slates, brick for the segmental arch heads, timber for the air conditioning plant enclosure and the external brickwork (including details of mortar and profile) to be used in the construction of the external surfaces hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (Design and Access Statement, P445-SK/001,002, Roof plan existing and proposed received 10/4/12.
Amended plans: P445-SK/004C,005C, Elevations as existing, Elevations as proposed received 2/7/12) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as otherwise varied by the conditions below or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is occupied/used.

Condition : 4 - There should be no demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations and extension hereby approved necessitate the removal of parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until details of, in the case of intervention in original walls nib and/or downstands which are to be retained to show the historical past of the building have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 6 - No development shall take place until detailed plans at a scale of 1:25 of the proposed new entrance door have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - No development shall take place until detailed specification at a scale of 1:25 describing the making good of the points of intervention, where the proposed extension meets the existing building junction where the proposed extension would meet the existing building.
Condition : 8 - The existing corbel detail on the existing roof shall be carefully dismantled and the materials salvaged to be reused in the approved position.

Condition : 9 - Details of the proposed suspended ceilings in respect of window heads shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to installation.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details
description: Erection of a two storey extension to create a new access and stairway enclosure into the N.E. Wing of the building and erection of internal partitions to create disabled WC facilities and subdivide main room at ground floor and installation of a platform lift.
